title: SWRD=2 Optional Transactional Root-History State
purpose: Add only the irreducible SWRD=2 root-depth history to the common crop lifecycle carrier while keeping SWRD=1 state-free for root depth and refusing to duplicate WRT as an SWRD=3-only helper state.

SWRD_1.root_depth: reconstructible from committed DVS and immutable RDTB/RDM

SWRD_2.reason: both values are incrementally updated from their prior committed values and actual depth may lag potential depth under stress/assimilation limits

SWRD_3.reason: WRT is broader crop biomass state: fixed-crop derives/updates root biomass as crop state when active physics needs it, while WOFOST evolves s%wrt together with other organ biomass and publishes it to plant_interface. It must be owned by a broader biomass host/view, not duplicated solely for root geometry.

validation: common crop lifecycle validation must pass
actual_root_depth must be finite and nonnegative
potential_root_depth must be finite and nonnegative
maximum-root-depth RDM validation remains parameter/view-composition responsibility because RDM is immutable parameter data, not state
transaction_semantics: F-KT clone/checkpoint must retain the SWRD=2 dynamic subtype and both root-history values
trial mutation must not mutate committed state
same-checkpoint replay must be bitwise deterministic
SWRD=1 columns retain the smaller common crop lifecycle type and do not pay for SWRD=2 state
forbidden: runtime or solver ownership of crop root history
downstream_if_qualified: SWRD=1 and SWRD=2 can then obtain authoritative geometry inputs from new crop-owned state. SWRD=3 remains blocked on a broader crop biomass owner/view for WRT.
